# Smart File Converter

> Free online PDF & document converter tools suite. Merge, split, compress, and convert PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and image files instantly online with 100% privacy and zero registration required.

Smart File Converter (https://officialali.dev/) is a privacy-first web application providing 17 free online document processing and conversion tools.

## Core Capabilities

- **PDF Manipulation**: Merge, split, compress, unlock, protect, and add page numbers to PDF files.
- **Office Document Conversion**: Convert PDF to Word (.docx), PDF to PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF to Excel (.xlsx), Word to PDF, PPT to PDF, and Excel to PDF while preserving formatting, fonts, colors, and layout.
- **Image Processing**: Convert PDF to JPG, JPG to PDF, compress image size in KB, and convert between JPG, PNG, WEBP, and BMP image formats.
- **Multilingual PDF Translation**: Extract and translate PDF content into multiple target languages.

## Tools Directory

- [Merge PDF](https://officialali.dev/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized PDF file online for free.
- [Split PDF](https://officialali.dev/split-pdf): Separate PDF pages or extract specific page ranges into individual PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](https://officialali.dev/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size in KB/MB with selectable compression levels while maintaining visual quality.
- [PDF to Word](https://officialali.dev/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) files preserving formatting, tables, and images.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://officialali.dev/pdf-to-ppt): Convert PDF files into editable Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) presentation slides.
- [PDF to Excel](https://officialali.dev/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables and data from PDF documents into structured Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets.
- [Word to PDF](https://officialali.dev/word-to-pdf): Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) documents into standard PDF files.
- [PPT to PDF](https://officialali.dev/ppt-to-pdf): Convert Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations into PDF documents.
- [Excel to PDF](https://officialali.dev/excel-to-pdf): Convert Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets into formatted PDF files.
- [PDF to JPG](https://officialali.dev/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages into high-resolution JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF](https://officialali.dev/jpg-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, and BMP images into a single PDF document.
- [Unlock PDF](https://officialali.dev/unlock-pdf): Remove password protection and restrictions from PDF files.
- [Protect PDF](https://officialali.dev/protect-pdf): Encrypt and password-protect PDF files with 128-bit security.
- [Page Numbers](https://officialali.dev/page-numbers): Insert customizable page numbers into PDF documents.
- [Translate PDF](https://officialali.dev/translate-pdf): Translate PDF text into English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Urdu, and more.
- [Compress Image](https://officialali.dev/compress-image): Reduce image file size to a target KB limit without quality loss.
- [Convert Image](https://officialali.dev/convert-image-format): Convert images between JPG, PNG, WEBP, and BMP formats.
